technique_notes.key_id_target: driver_add() must be called on mesh_obj.data.shape_keys (bpy.types.Key), not the Object. Key inherits from ID and holds its own animation_data.
technique_notes.local_space: TRANSFORMS variable with LOCAL_SPACE reads the bone angle relative to its parent — joint-angle semantics. WORLD_SPACE folds in all ancestors.
technique_notes.scripted_ramp: max(0.0, min(1.0, (bend - REST) / (FULL - REST))) — linear ramp clamped to [0,1]. No built-in driver type supports arbitrary remapping.
technique_notes.bake_required: GLTF exporter samples keyframed FCurves; it does not evaluate live drivers. bake_driver() walks each frame, calls evaluated_get(dg) to read the resolved value, and writes a keyframe on the original shape key.
technique_notes.driver_remove: After baking, call key_id.driver_remove(path) so the action FCurves are the sole source; otherwise the driver and keyframes conflict at export time.
